background: Nordea is the largest bank in the Nordic region, headquartered in Helsinki, funded by deposits and covered bonds across Finland, Sweden, Norway and Denmark and lending to households and companies in all four.
synthesis: Rated AA on average across all three, the weakest at AA-, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratings are well ahead of the ratios: CET1 of 15.4% is below the median for EU and Nordic banks and leverage of 4.6% is in the bottom quarter, the weak spot. Liquidity is middling, LCR of 156% above the median and NSFR of 121% just below it, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
